bindings.surface_note: Exactly one read-only CASA import or frozen native EVLA source; there is no fallback.

bindings.name: native_cf_cache
bindings.surface_note: Native prepared-artifact cache; writable for generation actions and not readable by CASA.

bindings.name: evla_surface
bindings.surface_note: Explicit radius, height and slope reference-data file for the frozen homogeneous 25 m EVLA model; no CASA installation discovery.

bindings.name: native_cf_policy
bindings.surface_note: reuse-only validates a complete cache; generate-missing preserves valid cells; regenerate explicitly replaces all requested cells.

bindings.name: native_cf_working_size
bindings.surface_note: Explicit full even working-grid extent before support selection, not a requested output crop.

bindings.name: native_cf_oversampling
bindings.surface_note: Explicit integer convolution-plane oversampling; validated by the native application owner.

bindings.name: native_cf_cache_bytes
bindings.surface_note: Explicit catalog-wide storage bound in bytes, independent of cropped cell size. This is a request bound, not saved cache inventory.

bindings.name: native_cf_maximum_cells
bindings.surface_note: Explicit maximum admitted metadata-only paired-cell count, not serialized compiled catalog state.

bindings.name: cfcache
bindings.surface_note: Existing CASA CFS_/WTCFS_ input directory, imported read-only. This is never a native writable cache.

bindings.name: cf_resident_mb
bindings.surface_note: The AW cell cache in MiB, or auto: the memory the worker fit leaves free, from 256 MiB up to every cell; the runtime rejects zero.

bindings.name: save_continuum_residual
bindings.surface_note: Requires continuum subtraction; fit-only and nonselected cells, flags, and weights remain unchanged.
